artboards.title: abigail1-a · Library
artboards.handoff_comment:
brief: abigail-qualiware-blog-site-brief-1.md, ID abigail1 (Content Site - Brief Generator v1). Blog overview, direction "Library": a light, index-like library inspired by the Figma resource library the user pointed to (huge plain title, mono overlines, a big featured pair, then a filterable grid). Made 22 Oct at the user's request, one of three overview directions.
sections (in order):
  · header.bh (belongs to s1): the blog's own header, not the main site's menu: wordmark + "Blog" tag (link to the overview), topic shortcuts as buttons (All stories, User tips, News, Analyst recognition) that set the topic filter below (aria-pressed), a link back to qualiware.com and a black "Watch webinars" pill.
  · s1 Hero and featured: h1 112px PT Sans Regular with "blog" highlighted by a QW Green marker band behind black text; lede; "Featured stories" (PT Mono); two featured cards (16:10 big, 4:3 side): image, category chip, date, title, "Read story" link. Whole card is one link to the post page.
  · s2 All stories: h2; tool bar with the Topic filter (a button opening a panel of topics with post counts; Escape closes; the panel is open/closed with a tweak too), Sort (Newest, Oldest, A–Z; aria-pressed), and Search (live, by title). Status line (aria-live) says what is shown. 3-column grid of cards: 4:3 image (radius 12; analyst and screenshot images contained on white), category chips, date, title, "Read story". 9 cards, then "Load more stories". Empty state text when nothing matches. Hover: image scales 1.03 over .5s, title gets a QW Green underline.
  · s3 Go deeper: Dark Green band with the lead step: "Watch recorded webinars" and "Explore the platform" (the DTO page), and a photo.
  · s4 Main site footer: stands for qualiware.com's own footer, which the blog reuses (the brief leaves it out on purpose); drawn only so the page is complete. Do not design or build it from here.
data: the prototype holds 15 of the 54 posts on the current blog (qualiware.com/blogs), with their real titles, dates and images chosen from the images folder. The category of each post is an assumption (the current blog shows tags on posts, not categories); the counts per category are the current blog's. Filtering, sorting and search work in Play on these 15.
fonts used: PT Sans 400/700 (dominant), PT Mono (overlines, chips, dates).
derived colours (design guide § 2; hex = recipe · role): #e3f1ee = 62% Ice Blue + white · dividers (--line); #f3f9f7 = 27% Ice Blue + white · hover backgrounds, image wells (--surface); #525c72 = 66% Dark Blue + 34% Dark Grey · secondary text (--slate). Dark Blue at 18% for the panel shadow.
images (paths relative to images/): brand/qualiware-wordmark-black.svg, brand/qualiware-wordmark-white.svg (footer), illustrations/city-collage-blue.png, illustrations/gold-stars.png, photos/people/two-colleagues-at-laptop.png, and per post: illustrations/city-collage-blue.png, illustrations/city-collage-violet.png, illustrations/eye-collage-orange.png, illustrations/gold-stars.png, illustrations/lock-collage-orange.png, illustrations/manufacturing-collage.png, illustrations/planet-in-space.png, photos/people/people-reviewing-charts-documents.png, photos/people/team-workshop-sticky-notes-wide.png, photos/people/woman-presenting-with-tablet.png, photos/places/city-copenhagen.jpg, photos/places/city-london.jpg, product/screenshots/qualichat.png, restricted/analyst-and-awards/gartner-mq-dto.png, restricted/analyst-and-awards/info-tech-2026-leader-ea.png. The two analyst images (restricted/analyst-and-awards/) are used only on Analyst Recognition posts, as the design guide allows. Card images are decorative (alt=""): the title follows.
accessibility: contrast checked to WCAG 2.1 AA; the topic panel is a disclosure (aria-expanded, aria-controls, Escape); sort buttons and topic shortcuts use aria-pressed; the search field has a label; focus rings 3px Dark Blue (QW Green on Dark Green and black); hover motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
annotations: the bright red .sec-tag chips (#e60000, deliberately outside the brand palette) are canvas-only section labels for feedback, named <brief ID>-<artboard letter>-s<n> (e.g. "abigail1-a-s1"); sections are numbered in page order and renumber when a section is added, removed or moved, and artboard letters close up when an artboard is deleted; they are toggled by the "Show section labels" tweak, and clicking one in Play mode copies its name to the clipboard. Do NOT build them (nor the copy script).
prototype: links name their website page in data-goto (data-goto-else: the page to use until it exists): build each to that page's URL. The hrefs to board-NN.dc.html, onClick="{{navGo}}", goVals() and the onGo prop are canvas-only wiring for Play and previews: do NOT build them. Shared part site-footer (data-part): build it once, as one component on every page that has it; values set outside its markers are per page.
artboard role (canvas-only): Tweaks › Artboard › Role sets Lead, Alternative or Reference; the chip at the top-left shows the canvas page and the role. Only a page's Lead and its State artboards are built. Annotation only: do NOT build the chip.
section status (canvas-only): every section has a Tweaks group named after its label with seven toggles (Copy, Media, Interactions, Mobile, Motion, Translated, Tested); the red label shows "In development · n/7" until all seven are on, then "Approved". Annotation only: do NOT build.

  · s2 All stories: h2 42px; the search field comes first at full width, then Topic (full-width button, its panel full width under the bar) and Sort; one column of cards; full-width "Load more stories".
  · s3 Go deeper: text over photo, buttons full width.
  · s4 Main site footer: stands for the main site's phone footer: brand on top, then two columns of links (44px rows).
